title: Judith Seward Lidstone | Obituaries | rutlandherald.com
text:
Judith Seward Lidstone WALLINGFORD — Judith “Judy" Seward Lidstone, 86, of Wallingford, Vermont passed away Sunday, September 6, 2026, at her home, surrounded by her loving family. Born on March 25, 1940, in Rutland Vermont, Judy was the daughter of Allyn B. and Helen (Rounds) Seward. She graduated from Wallingford High School and Champlain College. Judy married her high school sweetheart, Ted Lidstone, in Wallingford, VT on June 11, 1960. After college, she worked at Howe Scale for several years and then took some time off to raise their three children. She then resumed her career at Mill River Union High School as a Special Education Teacher until her retirement in 1998. Judy is predeceased by her husband and sister, Anne Matulonis. Survivors include her two daughters Kimberly Bowen (Brian Gecha) of Brandon, VT, Kelly Doaner (Paul) of Clarendon, VT, and son Keith (Tara) of Wallingford, VT, grandchildren Matthew, Andrew (Eleanor) and Elise, and her brothers Charles Seward of St. Albans, VT and Michael Seward of Wallingford, VT. Judy had a wonderful and witty sense of humor and enjoyed spending time with her family and friends. She especially enjoyed being “Nana” to her three grandchildren and was always present and supportive at all of their activities. Judy and Ted enjoyed their 25 years of retirement and made many friends and memories while spending winters in Bradenton, FL. There will be a graveside service held on Saturday, September 26th at 10:00 am at the Scottsville Cemetery in Danby Vermont. A reception will follow at the Wallingford Rotary Building at 96 North Main Street, Wallingford, VT. The family would like to extend a very special thank you to all the wonderful staff at VNA & Hospice of the SW Region, private caregivers, and extended family, for all the love and support you provided.
Judith Seward Lidstone
